en.headline: 4 own commits plus 21 automated; 4 issues touched in openchamber
en.summary: On 2026-10-15, `sogeisetsu` made **4 own commits** across three repositories, plus 21 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, two own commits updated the agents docs to add a commit-attribution alias note and fixed the daily script so commit attribution supports aliases for non-GitHub account emails. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory`, one own commit tagged the `v1.15.5` release. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, one own commit added the initial commit. On the issues side, `sogeisetsu` opened issue #4920 in `openchamber/openchamber` about the context panel breakdown bar dividing whole-session estimates by the last message's input so `其他` is always 0%, commented on issue #4111 about orphaned MCP child processes after deleting a multi-run, and both commented on and closed issue #4346 regarding `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` still passing after `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` were removed in `d9fbf6b`. `sogeisetsu` also joined the existing discussion #4821 in `openchamber/openchamber` titled "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel". No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded for the day.

zh.headline: 4 次本人提交，另有 21 次自动提交；openchamber 中处理 4 个 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-15 当天，`sogeisetsu` 在三个仓库中共完成 **4 次本人提交**，另有 21 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交分别更新了 agents 文档以补充提交归属别名说明，并修复了 daily 脚本，使提交归属支持别名以兼容非 GitHub 账号邮箱的提交。在 `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 中，一次本人提交打了 `v1.15.5` 版本标签。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 中，一次本人提交完成了 initial commit。issue 方面，`sogeisetsu` 在 `openchamber/openchamber` 中开出了 #4920，指出上下文面板的 breakdown bar 用最后一条消息的 input 去分整场会话的估算值，导致 `其他` 恒为 0%；在 #4111 上留言，讨论删除 multi-run 后遗留的 MCP 子进程以及 `git worktree remove --force` 报 Permission denied 的问题；并对 #4346 留言后将其关闭，该 issue 涉及 `d9fbf6b` 移除 `onOpenMultiRun`/`canOpenMultiRun` 后 `SidebarHeader.test.tsx` 仍然通过。`sogeisetsu` 还参与了 `openchamber/openchamber` 中已有的讨论 #4821，标题为 "[Idea] Add session aggregate stats to the Context Usage Panel"。当天没有 PR、review 或 release 记录。
